name: Scalekit
description: Auth for AI agents: AgentKit runs each user's OAuth flow, vaults tokens and calls tools across 1,000+ connectors, and MCP Auth adds OAuth 2.1 to MCP servers you host.

skills.name: Vault Users' OAuth Tokens
skills.description: Runs each user's OAuth flow and stores their tokens in a vault, so agents keep access to the apps the user connected.

skills.name: Call Tools as a User
skills.description: Executes tool calls in apps like Gmail, Slack or Salesforce as the connected user, across more than 1,000 connectors.

skills.name: Serve Tools via Virtual MCP
skills.description: Bundles the tools an agent may use into a Virtual MCP server that MCP clients connect to as that user.

skills.name: Add OAuth to MCP Servers
skills.description: Adds an OAuth 2.1 authorization server to an MCP server you build and host, so MCP clients can sign users in.
